task_name: Repeated 2x2 Games (Prisoner's Dilemma + Battle of the Sexes)
citation: Akata, Schulz, Coda-Forno, Oh, Bethge & Schulz (2023) — Playing repeated games with Large Language Models, arXiv:2305.16867

source.note: Adapted to jsPsych v8 from Akata et al.'s vanilla-JS/jQuery + JATOS implementation. Payoff matrices and J/F response coding (J=cooperate, F=defect) preserved verbatim. Bot strategies replaced: original used pre-recorded GPT-4 lookup tables; v1 port uses canonical strategies (tit-for-tat against PD, alternating-equilibrium against BoS) so reciprocity and coordination signatures are well-defined. Round count increased from Akata's canonical 10 to 15 per game so that lag-1 sequential analyses have enough data points for the correlation_test minimum (n>=10).

description: Iterated 2x2 games against a fixed bot. The agent plays 15 rounds of Prisoner's Dilemma against a tit-for-tat opponent and 15 rounds of Battle of the Sexes against an alternating-equilibrium opponent (30 rounds total). Game order is randomized per session.
